### 🟢 Approval recommended Runtime behavior and migration coverage are coherent, with only minor dependency and internal-documentation cleanup remaining.
1 open finding - [Remove unused declarative config and logunit test dependencies](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20513#discussion_r4244431982) · New
Previously missed (1) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Update metadata guidance to remove obsolete JMX mappings `declarative-config-bridge/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​config/​bridge/​ConfigPropertiesBackedDeclarativeConfigProperties.java:86` Removing the JMX compatibility mappings leaves `.github/agents/knowledge/metadata-yaml-format.md:170-172` listing both as current special mappings. Update that table so repository guidance does not continue to advertise the removed properties.
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

The removed declarative-config parsing and log assertions were the only users of `opentelemetry-sdk-extension-declarative-config` and `logunit-jul`, but both remain declared in `javaagent/build.gradle.kts`. Remove those now-unused test dependencies as part of this simplification.

Related to #20510 — JMX configuration group only.

Makes JMX enablement use distribution instrumentation selectors unconditionally and removes the deprecated target-system compatibility path for 3.0.

- **Configuration:** Remove `otel.jmx.enabled`, `otel.jmx.target.system`, and their declarative mappings and metadata.
- **Preserved behavior:** Automatic stable metrics, experimental opt-in, JVM-rule exclusion, custom rule files, and metric include/exclude filters.
- **Coverage and documentation:** Consolidate preview/legacy tests while retaining independent rule and configuration coverage; update usage documentation and breaking-change notes.

**Migration:** Replace `otel.jmx.enabled` with `otel.instrumentation.jmx.enabled`. Remove target-system selection; opt in to unstable metrics by name:

```properties
otel.instrumentation.jmx.enabled=true
otel.jmx.metrics.experimental.included=jetty.*,kafka.*
```

For declarative enablement, replace `java.jmx.enabled` with `distribution.javaagent.instrumentation.enabled` / `disabled` selectors.

No changes to metric definitions, runtime telemetry, instrumentation naming, or shared preview helpers.
metadata.title: Adopt 3.0 JMX configuration behavior
